title: 'Birth of A Sport' Documentary - American Football in South Asia
quote_text:
Evan Rosenfeld and Jenna Moshell have created a powerful documentary titled "Birth of a Sport," the integration of American Football in India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan. Hear their interview discussing the tensions between players from India and Pakistan, how far the players have come since training camps, and how you can help finish this film.
